name: Easy Mark (Combat)
body:
Your bluster, bravado, and bladework leave your foes open to your attacks, and those of your allies.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Feint, distracting attack rogue talent, sneak attack +2d6

Benefit(s): When you hit a target in melee with a light weapon, you can make a Bluff check as a swift action to feint that target. If your target is already flanked or denied its Dexterity bonus, you sacrifice only one-half of your sneak attack damage rather than all of it when using your distracting attack.

Special: If you have the Greater Feint feat and successfully feint a target using this feat, your target is denied its Dexterity bonus against you and all allies adjacent to you until the end of your next turn.
